description:
Alavu is a calm, simple way to keep track of what you spend and earn.

Spaces for every part of life
Keep personal money, work expenses and a family fund apart. Each space has its own currency, categories and budgets, and you can move money between them with a transfer.

Budgets that follow your payday
Set a monthly budget overall or per category, and start the month on the day you get paid. Alavu shows how much is left and warns you gently as you get close.

Quick to add
Log an entry in a few taps, or without opening the app at all: ask Siri, run a Shortcut, or tap the widget or Control Center button.

Repeating entries and receipts
Add rent, salary or subscriptions once and Alavu records them on schedule. Attach a photo of the receipt to any entry.

Works offline
Everything is saved on your iPhone first and syncs when you are back online. Sign in with Apple or Google.

Private by design
Alavu doesn't connect to your bank and never sells your data. You decide what to record, and you can delete your account and everything in it from Settings at any time.
promotionalText: Track spending across personal, work and family money in separate spaces. Set budgets that follow your payday, and log an expense from Siri in seconds.
